description: Standing re-measure list for wave land. Mode-3 green alone is not wave exit. Near-void stills fail closed. Ship dist must be game-pack only.

mode_1.measure: shots/<label>/capture.json source includes browser-threejs; black_frame=false; pass_hard_gates=true
Aligned to measure black_frame: mean luma >= 38, unique samples >= 48, near_black_frac < 0.82, dims >= 64x64; black_frame must be false
mode_1.cmd: node tools/capture.mjs --label wave6 && node -e "const c=require('./shots/wave6/capture.json'); if(c.black_frame||!c.pass_hard_gates) process.exit(1)"

mode_1.measure: No Wooloo/TW plates under shots/wave* or shots/_sheets; contactsheet refuses minimal-capture and black_frame
docs/VISUAL-BAR.md sky/grade + soft light checklist vs TW presentation (not claim of mode-7 win)
dist is game-pack only: no content/canonical, content/derived, content/smoke, public/ab, or official warehouse names

mode_3.measure: npm run test:playtest green — starter, grass, battle, catch, heal, no official name leak

mode_4.measure: presented-frame (rAF-to-rAF) p99 ≤20ms @1080p medium (aa=false) during battle VFX plus work-time p99 ≤16.7ms; zero presented frames >50ms after warm-up
mode_4.note: Engine DPR capped at MEDIUM_1080P.maxPixelRatio=1; antialias=false. Presented p99_ms_max=20 accounts for the 60Hz floor; work p99_ms_max=16.7 is independently fail-closed. Reports separate >16.7ms, >20ms, and >50ms counts.

mode_5.measure: Input→menu ≤400ms; move→first attack frame ≤180ms; HP tween + AV feedback timestamps
mode_5.note: Mode 5 instrumented latencies required for ultracode wave exit; playtest green alone insufficient.

mode_7.measure: Labels-hidden forced choice: prefer our still over Twilight Wings reference
mode_7.cmd: node tools/capture.mjs --label wave6 && node tools/contactsheet.mjs --label wave6
mode_7.note: Mode 7 double-blind must prefer US over TW or keep looping. Wave-6 candidate beat prior 9/9 but the study reference won 11/12, so the strict target remains failed. Mode-3 green is NOT wave exit. Ballots only after ship-boundary green.

mode_7_note: Wave-6 relative gate passed (candidate beat prior 9/9); strict reference gate failed (study reference won 11/12). Playtest green is not sufficient.
land_cmd: npm run typecheck && npm run test:battle && npm run test:playtest && npm run build && node tools/check-ship-boundary.mjs && node tools/capture.mjs --label wave6 && node tools/profile.mjs --label wave6 --seconds 180 --gate --no-build
